claim: Exhaustive enumeration of all order-6 Sudoku grids (n=39168, first-row fixed) and order-6 Latin squares (n=1128960, first-row fixed) shows full rank over F_2 for the auxiliary matrix A_{ij}=L_{ij}-L_{i,n-1} (rank n-1 = 5) with incidence 6.6177% vs 6.1224%.  The pooled two-proportion descriptive comparison gives z = 4.013706 and two-sided erfc(|z|/sqrt 2) = 5.9773e-05.  At n=6 this is the determinant-paper rank-parity proxy (`full_rank_count` over F_2), not rank(P^T E P), and not the odd-rank locus (rank n-2) used at n in {7, 9, 11}; the box constraint nevertheless yields a small enhancement.

inputs.rank_parity_proxy: F_2 full rank of A_{ij}=L_{ij}-L_{i,n-1} (rank == n-1 == 5); not rank(P^T E P)
